body: Register row B-35 (docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md): docs/25 keeps two legal questions open: the app began as a fork under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (about 1.3 percent of lines still identical; whether anything must be kept or the project must stay non-commercial is undecided) and there is no THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES. The order is right (this item 72, public release P5-06 at 82) but the answer decides whether the repository may go public and whether an APK may be handed to a friend, so it must be done before either. The one owner decision goes to the advisor.
